finding: Let's Encrypt and sovereignweb.site: how many certificates, how much headroom, and why five sites are on http

sources.served_certificates: curl -k -w %{certs} https://<host> at 03:05Z (the upstream certificate, not this container's proxy)

lets_encrypt_limit.rule: New certificates per registered domain: 50, refilling one every 202 minutes (about 7 a day). Renewals of the same set of names do not count.
lets_encrypt_limit.bucket_model: Start full (50) at the first issuance, take one per issuance, refill one per 202 minutes, cap 50.
lets_encrypt_limit.at_measurement: about 4.3 at 03:00Z on 25 Nov, before puter.platform's certificate (so about 3.3 after it)
lets_encrypt_limit.sustained_rate: about 7 new names a day; peak demand was 28 (20 Nov) and 25 (22 Nov)
lets_encrypt_limit.model_caveat: The model says about 4 left at 03:00Z, but only one of two new sites got a certificate, so the real bucket is lower than modelled.

stuck_sites.dns: every one is a CNAME to sovereignwebsite.github.io; no CAA record on sovereignweb.site
stuck_sites.served: GitHub's default *.github.io certificate, so no certificate of their own yet; http answers 200
hosts: aws.agents.sovereignweb.site (also stuck, not in the original five)
stuck_sites.open_question: the Pages cert_state of each stuck site (Org apply sees it; Actions logs are not readable from this session). Asked a.factory at 03:05Z.

verdict: Likely: the stuck sites asked while the bucket was empty and GitHub does not retry by itself. Not proven by an error message. The 06:17Z sweep nudges every missing certificate at once; at most one will succeed.
correction: From a.factory, 03:07Z: Let's Encrypt backdates notBefore by about an hour, so puter.platform's certificate was issued at about 03:03Z, minutes after its site was created from IaC 0ce9bb5; nvidia.platform, created in the same push, got none. Stuck sites asked while the bucket was empty: uk-driving-test re-saved 00:35Z (cert_state new, run 45519256678), apple about 00:40Z, calendar about 00:52Z, the book about 01:45Z; scoped runs 45522692169 and 45529178989 planned no nudge, so no error state.
